title: Sum of All Subsets XOR Total
summary: For each selection of input positions, XOR the selected values and add that result to the total.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–12 entries in [1,20]. Return the exact integer sum.
contractDetails.output-checking: Count subsets by original position, including repeated values as independent choices. Serialize the exact integer total.

statement: For each selection of input positions, XOR the selected values and add that result to the total. The empty selection contributes zero. Equal values at different positions are separate choices.

examples.explanation: The two singleton choices each contribute 2.
Each bit occurs in four of the eight subset XOR values.

constraints: 1–12 entries in [1,20]. Return the exact integer sum.
hints: Conceptual: Selections are based on positions, even for equal values.
Implementation: For a bit present somewhere, toggle one position containing that bit to pair subsets with opposite XOR parity. Multiply the combined OR by 2^(n−1).
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space for the bit-contribution reference.
